QuestInfo.name: Boughs for the Lanterns
QuestInfo.1: For the Lantern Rite, the hearthkeepers built lantern frames from boughs the #o61#s gave freely. Collect #b30 #t4000058#s#k from #r#o61#s#k and bring them to #b#p711##k in #b#m010006140##k. He knows the way to the old tomb.
QuestInfo.2: I brought the #t4000058#s to #b#p711##k. He will build the lantern frames and guide the way to #b#m010006161##k once I am strong enough.

0.0: I've finished reading. Every winter, the hearthkeeper carried a lantern into the tomb for each name and laid a #bname-charm#k beside it. That was the Lantern Rite. It was how the fairies said goodbye.
0.1: The frames were made from fallen boughs. Long ago, the #r#o61#s#k gave them freely. They were the fairies' neighbors then, before the deep halls turned wild.
0.2: The #r#o61#s#k won't give anything freely now, I'm afraid. Could you gather #b30 #t4000058#s#k from them?
0.3: Take them to #b#p711##k in #b#m010006140##k. He has scouted the way to the old tomb in #b#m010006161##k, and he's handier with tools than I am.

yes.0: Thank you. I'll keep reading the journal. There's one last page I haven't made sense of yet.

no.0: There's no rush. The names in this journal have waited a long time. They can wait a little longer.

1.0: Boughs from the #r#o61#s#k? And #b#p712##k sent you? Let me guess: lantern frames.
1.1: Fascinating! I've seen lantern hooks carved into the walls of #b#m010006161##k, and I always wondered what they were for. Now I know!
1.2: I'll build the frames. But the tomb is crawling with things much nastier than #o61#s. Train up a little, then come back and find me. We'll go in together.

item.0: I'll need #b30 #t4000058#s#k for the frames. The #r#o61#s#k in #b#m010006140##k should have plenty.
